item: Stat-subscription refresh commits after each subscription, so a slow World Bank/Eurostat request no longer runs while the previous one's rows hold the write gate
summary: H1-1 of the WAL lane audit: store_figures flushes (taking the gate to the end of the transaction) and the next subscription's fetch ran on the same uncommitted session; now one commit per subscription, as governments.py does per indicator. Test probes the real gate-wired SessionLocal: gate free and takeable by a second thread during the fetch; red on the unfixed code. H1-3 (law diff inside the gate) closed as refuted: SessionLocal is autoflush=False so the first gate take is the flush after the diff; pinned by a test-only file. Not done: H1-2 (qualification/sitemap), owned by the qualification lane.
